_readme: version: CONTENT_VERSION, sent with every synced event. Bump it when any content file changes. Use a date (YYYY.MM.DD, with .N for a second release that day) or semver (1.2.3).
required: languages that must be complete. A missing key in one of them fails the build.
languages: display details for each i18n/<code>.json file (name in its own script; dir 'rtl' for right-to-left scripts).

To add a language, add i18n/<code>.json. That is the only required step. Add a line under 'languages' to give it a display name or 'rtl'. A file with "_meta": { "status": "machine_draft" } may be incomplete and stays hidden behind VITE_SHOW_DRAFT_LANGS.
